spec: Build an order-processing service. A REST API accepts new orders and writes them to DynamoDB, then publishes an event to an SQS queue for asynchronous fulfilment. An SNS topic notifies subscribers when an order status changes. Include endpoints to create orders, get order status, and list orders by customer.

complexity.rationale: A multi-service asynchronous order path combines persistence, queuing, and status notification.

congruence_checklist: GET endpoint listing orders by customer

plan.summary: A FastAPI REST service for order intake and tracking. Clients POST new orders, which are persisted to a DynamoDB table and then enqueued on an SQS queue for asynchronous fulfilment by a Lambda worker. Order status changes are published to an SNS topic so downstream subscribers are notified. Read endpoints expose single-order status lookup and per-customer order listings via a DynamoDB global secondary index.

endpoints.purpose: Create a new order: validate payload, write item to DynamoDB with status PENDING, send fulfilment message to SQS, publish initial status event to SNS, return the created order.
Fetch a single order's status and details from DynamoDB by primary key; 404 if not found.
List orders for a customer via required customer_id query parameter (optional status filter and limit), using the customer GSI.
Update an order's status in DynamoDB and publish the change to the SNS topic for subscriber notification.
Liveness/readiness probe reporting service and AWS client configuration status.

aws_resources.name: orders
aws_resources.justification: Primary store for order records. Partition key order_id serves GET /orders/{order_id}; GSI customer_id-created_at-index serves GET /orders?customer_id=... listings. PAY_PER_REQUEST billing.

aws_resources.name: order-fulfilment-queue
aws_resources.justification: POST /orders publishes a fulfilment event here for asynchronous processing, exactly as the specification requires.

aws_resources.name: order-fulfilment-dlq
aws_resources.justification: Redrive target for order-fulfilment-queue so repeatedly failing fulfilment messages are retained instead of lost.

aws_resources.name: order-status-topic
aws_resources.justification: The API and the fulfilment worker publish order status change events here to notify subscribers.

aws_resources.name: order-fulfilment-worker
aws_resources.justification: Cloud-side asynchronous consumer of order-fulfilment-queue (event source mapping): advances order status in DynamoDB and publishes the status change to the SNS topic. This is the async fulfilment execution the spec calls for, not hosting for the REST API.

aws_resources.name: order-fulfilment-worker-role
aws_resources.justification: Execution role for the fulfilment Lambda granting sqs:ReceiveMessage/DeleteMessage/GetQueueAttributes on the queue, dynamodb:GetItem/UpdateItem on the orders table, sns:Publish on the topic, and CloudWatch Logs write access.

aws_resources.name: order-service-app-policy
aws_resources.justification: Least-privilege policy/user for the standalone backend service covering dynamodb:PutItem/GetItem/UpdateItem/Query on the table and GSI, sqs:SendMessage on the queue, and sns:Publish on the topic.

aws_resources.name: /aws/lambda/order-fulfilment-worker
aws_resources.justification: Log group for the fulfilment Lambda, giving operational visibility into asynchronous processing failures and retries.
